scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,client -c gray,blue "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.node.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w client
